purpose: Teach: 組曲/のぞき/刺客/転居/つぐ/導か/病理/全土

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、製品ラインアップを組曲、つまり連作の様に整えろ
lines.en: I want our product lineup arranged like a suite—connected, cohesive. Make it happen.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Measured pace. The voice of someone used to being heard. No softening—direct instruction, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内ののぞき行為、つまり情報のぞき見対策を強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen our internal information security measures immediately.
lines.style: Respectful, businesslike. Quick agreement with no hesitation. Slightly lower register—not performing, just confirming receipt and compliance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合他社の刺客的人材引き抜きに警戒しろ
lines.en: And watch for talent poaching attempts from competitors. They're always circling.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact warning. Slight weight on 'always'—experience speaking. Conversational but serious, as if this is an old problem.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の転居時の情報更新を徹底します
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure customer information stays current when they relocate.
lines.style: Quick, assured response. Professional tone. Acknowledging the specific task without elaboration. Efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社長業を息子につぐ、つまり継ぐ準備を進めろ
lines.en: I'm beginning succession planning with my son. Start preparing the organization for that transition.
lines.style: Deliberate, slightly heavier. This is more than a directive—it's a significant decision being shared. Pause before 'transition,' letting the weight of it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様を購入に導かれる導線を整えます
lines.en: Understood. We'll streamline the customer pathway to purchase.
lines.style: Quick confirmation. Professional, forward-focused. No commentary—just intake and agreement to execute.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、品質の病理、つまり病理解析的アプローチを採り入れろ
lines.en: We need to analyze quality issues like a pathologist would—systematically, at every level.
lines.style: Thoughtful, instructional tone. Slight deliberate pace on the analogy. This is not a quick fix—it's a methodology shift. Clear but measured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。全土への配送網を整えます
lines.en: Confirmed. I'll ensure we have reliable distribution coverage nationwide.
lines.style: Final note—slightly more settled, closing the list. Still professional, but a touch of finality. Calm assurance.
